title: SkiaSharp view host control

implementation.keyMap: ViewKeyMap (dictionary, not a switch — BEEP0002 forbids a default arm over Key)
implementation.path: SKSurface -> SKBitmap (Bgra8888, premul) -> byte[] -> WriteableBitmap (Pbgra32) -> Image

gates.AC-1 paint: pass — Rendering_a_surface_produces_a_bgra_frame (200x120, stride 800, DrawContent ran once)
gates.AC-5 pinch/pan: pass — A_pinch_reaches_the_surface_with_its_scale, A_two_finger_pan_is_converted_to_surface_units; the host enables manipulation and forwards ManipulationDelta to HandlePinch / HandleTwoFingerPan
gates.AC-7 contained failure: pass — A_render_failure_is_reported_and_contained (Redraw false, one reported failure, no escaping exception, RenderCount 0)
gates.AC-8 accessibility: pass — The_host_exposes_the_surfaces_accessible_name_and_children (peer created, name 'Probe view', 2 children 'Depth' and 'Gamma ray'); control is Focusable/IsTabStop

limits: Touch manipulation was exercised through the renderer, not by injecting a real ManipulationDelta into the control; the host override itself is unproven by automation.
The per-frame pixel copy (SKBitmap -> byte[] -> WriteableBitmap) is not measured; that belongs to REL-04.
Only the WPF host is verified; no screenshot or screen-reader pass was run against a real window.
